name: How long does it take to remove a mildew smell professionally?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove a mildew smell professionally?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for professional mildew smell removal and mold remediation varies based on the severity and extent of the problem. For minor, localized issues, the process might take 1-3 days, including drying times. More extensive mold growth, especially if it's hidden or affects multiple areas, can extend the project to 3-7 days or even longer. This includes assessment, containment, mold removal, structural drying, cleaning, and deodorization. A professional restoration company can provide a more precise timeline after a thorough inspection of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional mildew smell and mold removal can take 1-7 days or more, depending on the problem's severity, extent, and location. A thorough inspection provides an accurate timeline.
